limitations: The primary article reports anticancer/cytotoxicity and in vivo antitumor evidence, not antimicrobial MIC/MBC rows.
Figure 1c contains additional plotted time points; only text-stated values were recorded as exact numeric rows.
The local supplement PDF is a qPCR primer table and does not add activity/toxicity endpoints.
DRAMP reports an LTX-328 FEMX-I target row, but primary Figure 1a supports only the B16F1 LTX-328 >350 µM row; this is preserved as a database target conflict.
